_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: shot types $0B $0C $2A $2B $2C ($960C-$975E). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPES $0B / $0C (ENEMY SHOTS): first frame? (type $0B)
regions.description: TYPES $0B / $0C (ENEMY SHOTS): `$0B` is aimed at the player when it is made, `$0C` flies in a direction the spawner gave. Stats of both: hit points 1, attack 32, collision flags 4, drawing flags `$13`, dies as type 8; the allocator may take a slot back from them (types `$0B-$0D`). Art blocks `$20` and `$06`, but the shot ignores them: it uses the fixed tile `$8A`.

regions.name: TYPES $0B / $0C (ENEMY SHOTS): speed class
regions.description: `$0698` := 3, then `JSR $963A` raises it to 5 when the player's shield level `$4B` is 4 or more: stronger shield, faster enemy shots.

regions.name: TYPES $0B / $0C (ENEMY SHOTS): aim
regions.description: `JSR $C0FC` (`$F85D`): the direction to the player and the velocity. RUN: from (100, 60) toward (200, 150) the shot moved 1 px right and 1 px down every frame.

regions.name: TYPES $0B / $0C (ENEMY SHOTS): picture and stats
regions.description: Metasprite `$25`, palette 0, tile `$06C8` := `$8A`, `JSR $C0AE` (the type's stats), `JSR $C162` (`$FE88`, the area scaling of hit points and attack, below). Shared with type `$0C`.

regions.name: TYPES $0B / $0C (ENEMY SHOTS): every frame
regions.description: `JSR $9646` (move and burst on blocks), `JSR $C0BD` (`$D276`: the hit test, mask 4) and `JMP $C0D5` (`$D2C5`: the consequences).

regions.name: Enemy shots: move, and burst on a block
regions.description: `JSR $9B53` (`JSR $C08D`: move and draw). If the shot is not initialised it returns from the caller too. Then `JSR $8435` (the class under the shot): a class in the table `$8513` (5-10, 14; the weapon-breakable and solid cells) turns the shot into an explosion (type 8, `$0740` := 0). So enemy shots burst on blocks in the labyrinth; in a corridor the class is always 0.

regions.name: TYPE $0C: first frame
regions.description: Speed class 3 (5 with a strong shield), the direction `$0788` set by the spawner into the velocity (`$F8CE`), then the shared `$961C`. RUN: direction 6 moved left and down.

regions.name: TYPE $2B (AN ANIMATED SHOT): set-up
regions.description: Stats and area scaling, class 4 (5 with a strong shield), the direction `$0788` into the velocity, sound `$40`, `JSR $C0A2`. Stats: hit points 1, attack 32, collision flags 0, drawing flags `$13`, art block 0 (it uses fixed tiles).

regions.name: TYPE $2B (AN ANIMATED SHOT): every frame
regions.description: The four-phase animation (`$96AC`, step `$40`), `JSR $9646` (move; bursts on blocks), `JSR $C0C6` (`$D294`, hit test, mask `$30`), `JMP $C0D5`.

regions.name: TYPE $2B (AN ANIMATED SHOT): the animation
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` over 4 phases: metasprite `$96C4[phase]` (`1A 79 37 79`), palette `$96C8[phase]` (`00 01 02 43`), tile `$06C8` := `$96CC[phase]` (`F8 FA FC FA`, absolute tile numbers). RUN: metasprites 26, 55, 121 and palettes 0, 2, 67 over the first frames.

regions.name: Shot animation: tile numbers
regions.description: `F8 FA FC FA`.

regions.name: TYPE $2A (A LOBBED FRAGMENT): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $2A (A LOBBED FRAGMENT): bit 7 set goes to the spring (`$972A`). Stats: hit points 4, attack 16, collision flags 4, drawing flags `$13`, dies as type 8.

regions.name: TYPE $2A (A LOBBED FRAGMENT): which variant
regions.description: `$0728` (the hit box's bottom edge) zero at creation takes the plain form (`$96FE`); non-zero takes the form with art of its own. Only the first was seen made in a game; the second I made by setting `$0728` by hand.

regions.name: TYPE $2A (A LOBBED FRAGMENT): variant with its own art
regions.description: `$07B8` is the tile block (`$C0AB`) and `$07A0` the tile offset (`$A1E7`).

regions.name: TYPE $2A (A LOBBED FRAGMENT): variant: tougher
regions.description: Attack and hit points doubled; in corridor `$16` the hit points are `$FF`; collision flags := 0 (it can be hit by anything). RUN: attack 16 -> 32 and hit points 4 -> 8.

regions.name: TYPE $2A (A LOBBED FRAGMENT): plain variant
regions.description: Stats, metasprite `$25`, palette 0, `$07B8` := 0, tile `$8A`.

regions.name: TYPE $2A (A LOBBED FRAGMENT): the throw
regions.description: Area scaling (`$C162`), y speed `$05D8` := `$FE` (-2, up) and the y target `$0668` := `$FE`, the x speed `$0608` := `$0788` (the spawner's value), a random x fraction `$05F0`.

regions.name: TYPE $2A (A LOBBED FRAGMENT): gravity
regions.description: `JSR $C09C` with A = `$14`: the y speed is pulled toward the target by 20/256 a frame. RUN: it rose from y 58 to 36 and fell, moving 3 px a frame sideways, and left the screen by frame 60.

regions.name: Shared shot tail (types $2A and $2C)
regions.description: Collision flags bit 2 set: only the drawing and the bursting (`$9631`). Otherwise `JSR $C08D` (move and draw), `JSR $C0C6` (hit test, mask `$30`), `JMP $C0D5`.

regions.name: TYPE $2C (A SLOW DROPPING OBJECT; the Clawbot's arms): all of it
regions.description: First frame: `$07B8` is the tile block (`$C0AB`), area scaling, `$07A0` the tile offset, `$0788` the direction into the velocity (`$F8CE`; with the speed class 0 the velocity is left as the creator set it); then every frame the shared tail `$972F`. Stats: hit points 16, attack 16, drawing flags `$1F`, dies as type 8. The Clawbot makes two with flags `$52`, `$07B8` = `$2A`, hit points `$FF` and a y speed of `$30`/256: RUN: they sank 0.19 px a frame (96 -> 126 in 160 frames), their hit points ticking down only when something hit them.
